conditions: This applies to an abstract CDS entity in the scope of SAP AS ABAP 7.54.
limitations: An abstract CDS entity has no database object. SAP expressly excludes its use as a data source for ABAP SQL SELECT.

triggers: Evidence correction, scope change, or contrary primary material.

statement: SAP's ABAP 7.54 documentation permits the structured type of an abstract CDS entity after TYPE in an ABAP program.
